# Expressions

One dispatch table, keyed by name and the runtime type of the first
argument. `any` means the operator does not care.

| Operator | Accepts | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `abs` | any | The magnitude of a number, ignoring its sign. |
| `add` | dict, float, int, list, str | Adds numbers, joins strings, or concatenates lists. |
| `all` | any | True when every element is truthy. |
| `any` | any | True when any element is truthy. |
| `assert_no_nulls` | any | Check that the named columns have no missing values. |
| `assert_rowcount` | any | Check how many records there are. Returns the data unchanged. |
| `assert_schema` | any | Check that the records have the expected columns and types. |
| `assert_unique` | any | Check that a column, or a combination, has no duplicates. |
| `avg` | any | The mean of a list of numbers. |
| `bool` | any | Converts a value to true or false. |
| `cast_schema` | any | Coerce columns to the named types, leaving unlisted ones alone. |
| `ceil` | any | Rounds up to a whole number. |
| `chunk` | list | Splits a list into batches of a given size. |
| `clamp` | any | Constrains a number to a range. |
| `coalesce` | any | The first argument that is not null. |
| `concat` | any | Stack tables or lists of records end to end. |
| `contains` | any | True when a collection holds a value. |
| `contains_by` | any | True when the left side is inside the right. |
| `convert` | any | Read one file and write it out in another format. |
| `count` | any | How many elements a collection holds. |
| `date` | any | Parses a value as a date and time. |
| `date_add` | any | Shifts a date by a number of days, hours, or minutes. |
| `date_diff` | any | The gap between two dates, in days by default. |
| `date_format` | any | Renders a date using a format string. |
| `dedupe` | any | Remove duplicate records, optionally comparing only some columns. |
| `default` | any | The value, or a fallback when it is null or empty. |
| `describe` | any | Per-column statistics: count, nulls, distinct, and min/max where meaningful. |
| `div` | float, int | Divides; division by zero is an error, not infinity. |
| `div_safe` | any | Divides, returning a fallback instead of failing on zero. |
| `drop` | list | Everything after the first n elements. |
| `ends_with` | str | True when the string ends with a suffix. |
| `entries` | dict | An object as a list of key/value pairs. |
| `eq` | any | True when both sides are equal. |
| `example.echo` | any | Return what it was given, `times` times. |
| `explode` | any | Turn each element of an array field into its own row. |
| `extract` | str | The first regex match, or a capture group. |
| `extract_all` | str | Every regex match in the string. |
| `fill_nulls` | any | Replace null or missing fields with defaults. |
| `filter_rows` | any | Keep rows whose column matches the supplied checks. |
| `first` | list | The first element, or null when empty. |
| `flatten` | any | Flatten nested objects into underscore-joined columns, or nested lists into one. |
| `floor` | any | Rounds down to a whole number. |
| `floordiv` | float, int | Divides and rounds down to a whole number. |
| `format` | any | Fills {} placeholders in a template, positionally. |
| `fs.copy` | any | Copy a file, creating the destination's directory. Returns the new path. |
| `fs.exists` | any | Whether a path is there. Never raises -- that is the point of it. |
| `fs.glob` | any | Paths matching a pattern, sorted, with size and mtime. |
| `fs.mkdir` | any | Create a directory and its parents. Returns the path. |
| `fs.move` | any | Move or rename a file. Returns the new path. |
| `fs.remove` | any | Delete a path. A directory needs `directory=true`, said out loud. |
| `fs.stat` | any | What is known about one path. |
| `ge` | any | True when the left side is larger or equal. |
| `glob_read` | any | Read every file matching a pattern, concatenated by default. |
| `greet` | any | Say hello. The smallest thing a plugin can contribute. |
| `group_agg` | any | Group records and aggregate the other columns. |
| `group_by` | list | Groups elements into an object keyed by a field. |
| `gt` | any | True when the left side is larger. |
| `has_secret` | any | Whether a credential is available, without reading it. |
| `head` | any | The first n records. |
| `infer_schema` | any | The column types the records imply. |
| `int` | any | Converts a value to a whole number. |
| `is_empty` | any | True when the value is null, empty, or blank. |
| `is_null` | any | True when the value is null. |
| `join` | any | Join two tables on shared columns, or join a list into a string. |
| `json_encode` | any | Renders a value as a JSON string. |
| `json_parse` | any | Parses a JSON string into a value. |
| `keys` | dict | The field names of an object. |
| `last` | list | The last element, or null when empty. |
| `le` | any | True when the left side is smaller or equal. |
| `list` | any | Wraps a value in a list, or leaves a list alone. |
| `lower` | str | Lowercases a string. |
| `lt` | any | True when the left side is smaller. |
| `matches` | str | True when a regular expression matches anywhere. |
| `max` | any | The largest value. |
| `median` | any | The middle value of a list of numbers. |
| `merge` | any | Merge records or objects; later values win on a shared key. |
| `min` | any | The smallest value. |
| `mod` | float, int | The remainder after division. |
| `mul` | float, int | Multiplies two numbers, or repeats a sequence. |
| `ne` | any | True when the two sides differ. |
| `neg` | float, int | Negates a number. |
| `normalize` | any | Flatten and align records so every one has the same fields. |
| `now` | any | The current UTC time. |
| `number` | any | Converts a value to a number. |
| `omit` | dict | An object without the named fields. |
| `pad_left` | str | Pads a string on the left to a given width. |
| `pad_right` | str | Pads a string on the right to a given width. |
| `pick` | dict | An object with only the named fields. |
| `pivot` | any | Turn distinct values of one column into columns of their own. |
| `pluck` | list | Return one column as a list, preserving row order. |
| `pow` | float, int | Raises the left side to the power of the right. |
| `profile` | any | A summary of the data: row count, columns, types, and null counts. |
| `read` | any | Read a file, choosing the format from the extension. |
| `read_csv` | any | Read a CSV file into a table. |
| `read_excel` | any | Read a sheet of an Excel workbook into a table. |
| `read_json` | any | Read a JSON file, keeping whatever shape it holds. |
| `read_ndjson` | any | Read newline-delimited JSON into a list of objects. |
| `read_parquet` | any | Read a Parquet file into a table. |
| `rename` | any | Rename columns. |
| `replace` | str | Replaces every occurrence of one substring. |
| `reverse` | list | The elements in reverse order. |
| `round` | any | Rounds to the given number of decimal places. |
| `row_number` | any | Add a stable row number column. |
| `sample` | any | A few records, evenly spaced through the data rather than just the first few. |
| `save` | any | Write a value, choosing the format from the file extension. |
| `save_csv` | any | Write records to CSV, flattening nested objects into underscore columns. |
| `save_excel` | any | Write records to an Excel workbook. |
| `save_json` | any | Write a value as JSON, preserving its nesting. |
| `save_ndjson` | any | Write records as newline-delimited JSON, one object per line. |
| `save_parquet` | any | Write records to Parquet: columnar, compressed, and typed. |
| `secret` | any | The named credential. Fails loudly rather than sending an empty header. |
| `select` | any | Keep only the named columns. |
| `slug` | str | A lowercase, dash-separated form safe for filenames. |
| `sort` | list | The elements sorted, optionally by a field. |
| `sort_by` | any | Sort records by one or more columns. |
| `split` | str | Splits a string into a list. |
| `sqlite.exec` | any | Run a statement that returns no rows. Reports what it changed. |
| `sqlite.query` | any | Run a SELECT and return the rows as objects. |
| `sqlite.schema` | any | The tables in a database and their columns, or just one table's. |
| `sqlite.write` | any | Write records into a table, creating it from the first row if it is not there. |
| `starts_with` | str | True when the string begins with a prefix. |
| `sub` | float, int, list | Subtracts the right side from the left. |
| `sum` | any | The total of a list of numbers. |
| `take` | list | The first n elements. |
| `text` | any | Converts any value to its string form. |
| `text.extract` | any | Extract a regex group from text or from a field in each record. |
| `text.join` | any | Join values into text. |
| `text.slug` | any | Turn text into a URL- and filename-friendly slug. |
| `text.split` | any | Split text into parts. |
| `text.template` | any | Format one record, or each record, with `{field}` placeholders. |
| `timestamp` | any | A date as seconds since the epoch. |
| `to_table` | any | Convert records into a table. |
| `today` | any | Midnight UTC today. |
| `trim` | str | Removes leading and trailing whitespace. |
| `type_of` | any | The name of a value's type. |
| `unique` | list | The distinct elements, in first-seen order. |
| `upper` | str | Uppercases a string. |
| `url_encode` | any | Percent-encodes a value for use in a URL. |
| `values` | dict | The values of an object. |
| `zip` | list | Pairs elements of two lists positionally. |
